rudra::fspec::ParamEntry::justified_contain_in_space src/fspec.rs (fspec.cc:248-283 with the address.cc:133/cc:269 space guards)
status_detail: The seven-case covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4: unjustifiedContainer iterates all entries with the minSize gate before justifiedContain, rejects foreign-space queries inside the walk (address.cc:133 / fspec.cc:269 / per-piece for joins), reaches join entries with the containing PIECE as container, and returns false early on just==0; fillinMapFallback's two trial queries (cc:1656 evaluate and cc:1702 best re-evaluate) are space-aware, so join output entries match register/ram trials per piece (the caller-level getSpace() guard had made them unreachable -> bestentry null -> all trials markNoUse), the best loop overwrites per-entry state, the offmatch contiguity walk, minSize coverage gate, type/cover preference and the firstOnly skip behave per cc:1638-1719. Overall remains UNTESTED because big-endian space rows are unreachable (the transitional enum AddressSpace is little-endian only, ADDRESS-0001) and the fspec.rs-level functions are exercised directly rather than through the full ParamActive recovery pipeline (ActionCopy/FuncCallSpecs closure not part of this fixture).

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-fspec-spaceless-rem-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

architecture.spaces: constant=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6; byte addressed, wordsize 1, all little-endian
architecture.space_construction: FixtureTranslate/AddrSpace inserts ConstantSpace, OtherSpace, UniqueSpace, three IPTR_PROCESSOR AddrSpaces (ram index 3, register index 4) and an IPTR_SPACEBASE stack (index 5) with AddrSpace::hasphysical; JoinSpace index 6 is constructed for the join ParamEntry spaceids

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: no cspec decode; staged ParamEntry resources (uc_plain: reg [0x100,0x107] min2 exclusion force-left + ram [0x100,0x10F] min4 align8 + reg [0x200,0x207] min4 exclusion force-left; uc_join: join ram:0x204+reg:0x100 min4 plus plain reg [0x100,0x107] min4 exclusion force-left; fb_plain: reg [0x100,0x107] min4 exclusion force-left first + ram [0x100,0x10F] min4 align8 first + reg [0x100,0x107] min8 exclusion force-left first; fb_join: join reg:0x104+reg:0x100 min4 first + reg [0x200,0x207] min4 exclusion force-left first; fb_cross: join ram:0x204+reg:0x100 min4 first; fb_first_only x2: reg [0x100,0x107] min4 exclusion force-left first + reg [0x108,0x10F] min4 exclusion force-left NOT-first)
compiler_spec.calling_convention: hand-built ParamEntry/ParamListStandard(out)/JoinRecord/ParamActive via the staged loader (C++ direct field writes under the class->struct access hack, Rust pub builder setters + set_join_pieces + register_trial_in_space); populateResolver is intentionally NOT called — unjustifiedContainer and fillinMapFallback never touch the resolver

analysis_options.api: Direct production ParamListStandard::unjustifiedContainer and ParamListStandardOut::fillinMapFallback calls on both sides; no Action, Rule, PrintC or Funcdata pipeline
analysis_options.model_state: uc cases: (space,offset,size) queries against staged entry lists; fb cases: active trials (markActive) registered at distinct slots/addresses, fillin_map_fallback invoked with firstOnly=false except the two first_only cases (true/false pair)
analysis_options.normalization: None. uc rows print hit 0/1 verbatim and, for hits only, the res container as space:0xoffset/size; fb rows print the post-call trial order (sortTrials result) with used 0/1, entry as list index (-1 none) and the justified offset — Ghidra's ParamEntry* maps to the index of the identical list element
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and queries are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; all queries stay on valid inputs

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: ParamListStandard with three plain entries (reg [0x100,0x107] min2 exclusion force-left, ram [0x100,0x10F] min4 alignment 8, reg [0x200,0x207] min4 exclusion force-left), NO populateResolver
cases.queries: 7 rows: uc spc/off/sz -> hit 0/1 (+ res container on hits)
cases.expect: fspec.cc:1411-1424 iterates the entry list with the cc:1415 minSize gate BEFORE justifiedContain (reg 0x202/2 is skipped for the min-4 e2 -> hit=0; reg 0x100/1 skips everything): the unjustified reg 0x104/4 returns the whole e0 container register:0x100/8, the aligned ram 0x104/8 walks the alignment!=0 route (just=4) and getContainer rounds up to ram:0x100/16, ram 0x108/8 is aligned-justified so just==0 returns false early, and the stack query at the numerically coincident offset 0x104 is rejected inside the walk (address.cc:133 / fspec.cc:269) -> hit=0

cases.setup: join ParamEntry (pieces MS-first ram:0x204 high + reg:0x100 low, min4) followed by plain reg [0x100,0x107] min4 exclusion force-left, NO populateResolver
cases.queries: 6 rows: uc spc/off/sz -> hit 0/1 (+ res container on hits)
cases.expect: join entries ARE reachable through the per-piece walk: the reg 0x104/4 query pokes out of the low piece and meets the foreign ram high piece (-1, +4 skip) so the join returns -1 and e1 supplies just=4 -> register:0x100/8; the ram 0x204/4 query skips the foreign low piece (+4) into the containing high piece (cur=0 -> 4) and getContainer returns the PIECE ram:0x204/4; reg 0x100/4 hits the low piece with just=0 -> early false; reg 0x204/4 (numeric coincidence with the foreign high piece) and the stack 0x102/2 query are rejected by the per-piece address.cc:133 guard -> hit=0 (the old spaceless arithmetic accepted both rows)

cases.setup: ParamListStandardOut with three first-in-class entries (reg [0x100,0x107] min4 exclusion force-left, ram [0x100,0x10F] min4 align8, reg [0x100,0x107] min8 exclusion force-left) and three active trials reg 0x104/4, reg 0x100/4, stack 0x104/4
cases.queries: 1 fillin_map_fallback(active, false) call; 3 rows: final trial order with used/entry/joff
cases.expect: e0 evaluates both register trials (joff 4 and 0) -> putative match; e1 clears everything (foreign space, putative false, continue before sort); e2 re-evaluates and ties (offmatch 8, GENERAL not < GENERAL, 8 not > 8) so best stays e0; the best loop re-marks both register trials used with entry=0 and the stack trial is cleared and markNoUse; final sort orders entry trials by justified offset (0 then 4) with the entry-less trial last

cases.setup: ParamListStandardOut with a first-in-class join entry (reg:0x104 high + reg:0x100 low, min4) plus reg [0x200,0x207] min4 exclusion force-left, and two active register trials 0x100/4 and 0x104/4
cases.expect: the core divergence row: the cc:1656 walk matches both register trials per piece (joff 0 and 4) -> putative match, offmatch 8 covers min4, GENERAL < PTR -> best = the join entry; the cc:1702 best loop marks both trials used with entry=0; e1 matches nothing; the old caller-level getSpace() guard made the join unreachable, so bestentry stayed null and every trial was markNoUse

cases.setup: ParamListStandardOut with a single first-in-class join entry (ram:0x204 high + reg:0x100 low, min4) and three active trials reg 0x100/4, ram 0x204/4, stack 0x204/4
cases.expect: the register trial hits the low piece (joff 0), the ram trial skips the foreign low piece (+4) into the high piece (joff 4), offmatch 8 covers min4 -> best = the join and both are marked used entry=0; the stack trial meets only foreign pieces (-1) -> cleared and markNoUse, entry-less last in the final order

cases.setup: ParamListStandardOut with reg [0x100,0x107] min4 exclusion force-left first-in-class plus reg [0x108,0x10F] min4 exclusion force-left NOT first-in-class (single group), and one active trial reg 0x108/4
cases.expect: the cc:1649-1652 firstOnly skip fires for e1 (!isFirstInClass && isExclusion && getAllGroups().size()==1); e0 does not contain 0x108 -> putative false, bestentry null -> the trial is markNoUse with entry cleared (joff 0 from setEntry(null,0))

cases.setup: same entry layout and trial as fb_first_only_skip
cases.expect: with firstOnly=false e1 is evaluated: the trial justifies (joff 0) -> set_entry, offmatch 4 covers min4, k reaches numTrials, GENERAL < PTR -> best = e1; the best loop marks the trial used with entry=1

observation_schema.format: 31 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope, seven case headers, then 7 uc rows, 6 uc rows, 3 fb rows, 2 fb rows, 3 fb rows, 1 fb row and 1 fb row
observation_schema.branches: uc rows print unjustifiedContainer's 0/1 and, for hits only, the res container (space:0xoffset/size) — res is never read on miss rows (Ghidra leaves it unwritten); fb rows print the post-call trial state (space, offset, size, used, entry index, justified offset) in the final sorted order
observation_schema.classification: entry index -1 encodes Ghidra's null ParamEntry*; joff is the raw getOffset() including the setEntry(null,0) clearing value

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: unjustifiedContainer writes res (VarnodeData&) ONLY through getContainer on a hit row (miss rows leave the caller's sentinel untouched on both sides); fillinMapFallback mutates every trial in place: setEntry/clearEntry per evaluation, markUsed/markNoUse in the best loop, and the trial VECTOR is reordered by sortTrials — both sides observe the same final order
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: both functions iterate entry.begin()..entry.end() in list order (uc: cc:1414 minSize gate inside; fb: cc:1646 with the firstOnly skip at cc:1649-1652); the trial loops run 0..getNumTrials(); the offmatch walk (cc:1670-1683) breaks on the first offset mismatch and continues (k++ without offmatch growth) over entry-less trials; the join walk (cc:253) runs pieces least significant first; getContainer's join route (cc:300) also walks pieces least significant first
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: the join walk accumulator res (cc:252) adds vdata.size only for non-containing pieces (cur < 0, including the address.cc:133 foreign-space -1) and returns res+cur on the first containing piece; offmatch accumulates trial sizes only while trial.getOffset() == offmatch (cc:1672); bestcover/bestclass persist across entry iterations (reset only before the loop); k is reset to 0 when offmatch < minSize (cc:1684)
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: uc acceptance keys are just < 0 continue / just == 0 early false / otherwise first container wins; fb preference is (k == numTrials) && (type < bestclass || offmatch > bestcover) evaluated per entry in list order; the final sortTrials key is entry null last, then group, then entry identity, then offset for exclusions (alignment==0), else address (reverseStack-aware) then size

coverage.uc_plain_space_guards: MATCH (7/7 rows: unjustified and aligned containers, just==0 early false on both exclusion and aligned routes, foreign-space rejection at a numerically coincident offset, minSize gate before the walk on two rows)
coverage.uc_join_reachability: MATCH (6/6 rows: PIECE container from both pieces, foreign-piece skip accumulator, numeric-coincidence rejection, low-piece justified early false, minSize gate)
coverage.fb_plain_best_cover: MATCH (3/3 rows: best-cover selection, best-loop overwrite of per-entry state, tie rejection, foreign-space trial no-use, final order by justified offset)
coverage.fb_join_reachable: MATCH (2/2 rows: join entry selected as best with both trials used — the row where the old caller-level guard forced markNoUse for every trial)
coverage.fb_cross_space_join: MATCH (3/3 rows: per-piece space matching for both pieces, foreign-space trial rejection, contiguous offmatch accumulation)
coverage.fb_first_only: MATCH (2/2 rows: cc:1649-1652 skip under firstOnly, same layout reaches e1 with firstOnly=false)
coverage.be_space_rows: UNTESTED (proposed residual: the transitional enum AddressSpace cannot stage big-endian pieces/spaces; ADDRESS-0001)

residuals.detail: Both remaining spaceless justified_contain callers are space-aware and oracle-pinned: ParamListStandard::unjustified_container threads the query space into justified_contain_in_space (foreign-space numeric coincidences rejected, join PIECE containers reachable, minSize gate before the walk), and ParamListStandardOut::fillin_map_fallback routes both trial queries (cc:1656/cc:1702) through justified_contain_in_space with the caller-level getSpace() guard removed (join output entries reachable).
BE-space rows: the enum AddressSpace model is little-endian-only, so big-endian justification arithmetic (address.cc:138 off1-off2 branch) stays unreachable through these callers.
